messages.subject: Contributing to docs
parts:
Hi,
during my time learning INLA I noticed a few minor problems in the docs (mostly things that could be clarified to help beginners like myself). My initial idea was that I will just fork the repo and file a pull request with the fixes. But I was unable to find any contribution guidelines and also I don't really know how the Bitbucket pull request system for hg works. So what is the proper way to contribute? Or should I just file an issue or send the suggestions here?

Thanks
Martin Modrák

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Contributing to docs
parts:
Hi,
I believe the bitbucket system for pull requests works similarly to github, but I haven’t used either myself. I’d be happy for you to try it out!
Otherwise, opening an issue would also be helpful to us.

Finn
